newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's EEI 1996 contracts surge 85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila's EEI 1996 contracts surge 85 pct.

text.p: Philippine engineering firm EEI Corp said on Friday that its orders and contracts in 1996 climbed by 85 percent to 7.4 billion pesos from 4.0 billion the previous year.
EEI chief executive officer Teodorico Taguinod said in a statement that the firm's orders backlog amounted to 5.4 billion pesos at the end of 1996.

As of the end of February, Taguinod said the backlog rose to 6.8 billion pesos due to the acquisition of major projects which include the substructure and foundation works for the RCBC Plaza Towers in Makati City in Manila's financial district.
The projects also include the expansion of Petron's oil refinery in the northern province of Bataan.
EEI earlier this week reported 1996 net income of 264.198 million pesos versus 175.469 million pesos a year ago.
